mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video (store_id, course_id, schedule_id, video_date, title, file_url, cover_url, duration, file_size, scope_type, status) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{courseId}, #{scheduleId}, #{videoDate}, #{title}, #{fileUrl}, #{coverUrl}, #{duration}, #{fileSize}, COALESCE(#{scopeType},'checked_in'), 1)
mapper.delete: UPDATE video SET status=0 WHERE id = #{id} AND store_id = #{storeId}
mapper.sql: v.status = 1 AND ( (v.scope_type = 'checked_in' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM checkin ck WHERE ck.schedule_id = v.schedule_id AND ck.user_id = #{userId})) OR (v.scope_type = 'booked' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM booking b WHERE b.schedule_id = v.schedule_id AND b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.status IN ('booked','checked'))) OR (v.scope_type = 'custom' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM video_visible vv WHERE vv.video_id = v.id AND vv.user_id = #{userId})) )
mapper.select: SELECT v.* FROM video v WHERE v.store_id = #{storeId} AND ORDER BY v.video_date DESC, v.id DESC
